title: Gentle accommodation gathers a common course
meaning: Gentleness in action aimed at combining different needs is emotionally answered by a sense of focused movement in a common direction.
text: Strength in the physical position of this Energy Field appears in shared actions where a powerful impulse meets considerate handling. Temperance in energy motivates a combination of different needs and attention to rhythms that do not coincide. The Chariot in emotions adds a feeling of direction and common movement. You may act gently to find a decision that accommodates differences, while emotionally experiencing focus: efforts no longer scatter in every direction, although your wishes have not become identical.

For example, you prepare for a walk with a camera. One person wants to reach the viewpoint quickly, while the other wants to stop and photograph details. Instead of impatiently hurrying each other, you find a route with short stops and a clear final landmark. **We move together when our common course has room for different rhythms.** Pleasure comes from the direction of the shared day, rather than one way of spending time defeating the other. The route gives your difference a workable form.

A difficulty appears if the emotional lift of finding a course becomes a prohibition on changing pace. One person is already tired, but stopping seems to violate successful accommodation. The motive of combining needs quietly gives way to preserving movement at any cost. The Chariot in emotions requires no uninterrupted advance. Temperance in energy does not mean that a proportion found once must suit both people under every new condition.
